messages:
Marta D: Heads-up: the overnight revenue-report job shows a mismatch: Stripe receipts total != NetSuite invoiced total by $2,420 for run 2026-03-25. Looks scoped to invoices created between 00:50-01:10 UTC.

Leo B: Do you have an example invoice?

Marta D: Yes invoice 70055 shows two lines for a usage adjustment: one from the usage-agg pipeline and one manufactured by the reporting backfill. Both posted same amount.

Ashwin: Quick check: our reporting backfill reprocesses failed rows and will emit a compensating adjustment if it thinks the original write didn't complete. The comp path uses the db flag "reporting_repaired = true" but the backfill misread a partial commit and created duplicates.

Reporting Bot: [alert] revenue-report discrepancy detected run=rev-2026-03-25-00 delta=2420. See /logs/reports/2026-03-25/rev.log and /artifacts/2026-03-25/reconcile-dryrun-2175001111.csv

Marta D: Log snippet:

```
2026-03-25T00:59:10Z INFO report-backfill detect missing_row change_id change_321 -> emit compensating_adjustment invoice 70055 amount -120.00 id=ns_1601
2026-03-25T01:00:02Z INFO usage-agg processed change_id change_321 -> created proration line invoice 70055 amount -120.00 id=ns_1602
```

Leo B: So two adjustments for same change_id. Scope?

Marta D: Query returned 41 invoices with duplicate compensating adjustments in 00:50-01:10 UTC.

Ashwin: Root cause: backfill uses a read of the writes table to determine missing rows; when the writer had an in-flight transaction that later committed, the backfill still saw it as missing due to snapshot isolation timing and emitted compensation. We should make backfill check for concurrent commits before emitting a compensating adjustment.

Accounting: We need remediation steps. Prefer voiding compensating adjustments in NetSuite and reconciling ledger.

Marta D: I produced a CSV (artifact above) with invoice_num, dup_line_id, original_line_id, amount. Dry-run void script shows 41 candidates total $2,420.

Ashwin: Short term: pause report-backfill auto-repairs and add a final consistency check (read latest committed state) before emitting compensations. Filed infra#5555.

Leo B: Accounting: please review CSV and flag any >$100 impacts. We'll wait for your approval before running voids.

Reporting Bot: [info] repair-dryrun artifact uploaded: /artifacts/2026-03-25/reconcile-dryrun-2175001111.csv

Accounting: Reviewing now. Do not run any automated compensating emits until backfill is patched.

Ashwin: Will add integration test simulating commit-after-snapshot scenario. Also will add runbook note 'reports/backfill-await-commit' and an alert for "compensating-adjustments > 5 in 15m".

Marta D: Thanks. I'll coordinate with CS if any customers see balance changes >$75. Leave the alert open until voids done. :white_check_mark:
